title: Pseudopotential and structural effects on electronic properties in transition metal oxides using Wannier functions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30859-30871
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09637E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aykut Öztürk, Peter Kraus
The influence of pseudopotential and structure choices on transport properties of transition metal oxides such as band gap, high frequency-permittivity, and electrical conductivity is investigated using Wannier functions.
